response.original_title: I chyba nigdy nie jest inaczej
response.overview: Bukovina, a Carpathian province of the Austro-Hungarian Empire, on the eve of the First World War. Andrzej slips into the hayloft with the girl he loves, while his younger brother Dmytryk is supposed to keep watch. Then the girl's father walks into the dark barn with a lantern and an axe – and he is Andrzej's own godfather. Andrzej lies straight into his eyes, and the boy watching through the boards learns how the adult world works. Based on a scene from Maria Matios's novel of the same name.
response.title: Hardly Even Otherwise
